title: Stabilize navigation E2E mocked bootstrap console error detection
observed_behavior: The ready bead recorded that the full navigation E2E suite previously failed its navigation error guard because mocked dashboard bootstrap and connection paths emitted three unexpected console errors.
The navigation spec's error guard filtered broad EventSource, SSE, and event stream substrings, allowing mocked-backend noise to be hidden without proving the bootstrap harness was clean.
intended_behavior: The mocked API and Nostr bootstrap harness seeds relay-backed discovery and read-model contracts cleanly for navigation smoke tests.
The full navigation E2E suite reports real console or page regressions without broadly masking unexpected app errors.
The central documentation navigation assertion remains covered by the full navigation spec and a focused Playwright run.
out_of_scope: web build-warning cleanup owned by concurrent work
